verdicts.reason: A keeps one clean left edge for the logo, headline, subcopy, CTA and chips, and the hierarchy reads in order. Its flaws are the orphaned word 'here' on line two of the headline, a large gap between the headline and the subcopy, and the chip row running onto the peach circle. B has no shared left edge: the logo, headline, subcopy, CTA and chips all start at different x positions. Its CTA is pushed off-axis to the right, the chips break into a ragged 2+1 grid, and the subcopy sits jammed under the headline while the bottom right is left empty.
